Thread Follow-Ups: Keep the conversation going for a deeper understanding.
It's ironic Perplexity itself blocks crawlers: curl -sI https://www.perplexity.ai returns HTTP/2 403, and faking a browser user agent with curl also doesn't work.
Cloudflare found Perplexity still providing detailed info about restricted test domains that had robots.txt disallowing crawlers and were not publicly discoverable.
Article claims Perplexity AI is lying about their user agent to evade robots.txt and site blocks, citing stackdiary's 'Perplexity has a plagiarism problem' report.
When asked directly why it didn't respect robots.txt, Perplexity's chatbot apologized and said it should have respected the file, but the user called this a hollow scripted response.
Commenter says Perplexity's CEO publicly claimed moral superiority over Google/OpenAI for giving citations, which is ironic given the user-agent spoofing controversy.

User used a free 12-month Perplexity Pro offer: initially useful for quick queries like recipes or manuals, but quality declined as the company seemed to optimize for speed over accuracy, with links/references frequently mismatched to the text.
The 'Computer' research feature in Perplexity often fails to trigger via the UI, and when it does work, sessions frequently stall without returning an answer.

User reports being billed after trial end without the promised warning email, and that Perplexity customer support (possibly AI) acknowledged the failure but refused to help until escalated on Twitter.
For actual research, the user now prefers Claude or ChatGPT over Perplexity, saying results are higher quality and more accurate despite being slower.
Commenter says Perplexity 'never had a great product' and that its main draw was free Pro accounts, with many users leaving once the product's mediocrity became apparent and free trials ended.
Report claims Perplexity cites AI-generated 'best software' listicle sites en masse, raising concerns about it being manipulated by SEO/AEO spam.
User says they've used Perplexity's free tier (5 Pro searches/4 hours) for months and it has completely replaced Google for their needs.
Another commenter says Perplexity.ai itself 'has been pretty poor' for them after the honeymoon phase wore off.
